commentary: With market breadth resting at 52 and the scanner gate on CAUTION, veteran tape reading dictates restraint. The Nifty's 576-point surge on massive FII buying offers an impressive follow-through effort, yet Stan Weinstein's stage discipline warns against treating an initial relief burst as a confirmed Stage 2 environment. William O'Neil's CANSLIM methodology requires broad-based institutional sponsorship, distribution-day absence, and sector-wide leadership before aggressive capital deployment. At neutral breadth, we preserve capital, insist on asymmetric risk-reward pivots, and demand true C-and-A earnings acceleration. Exposure must remain progressive, taking pilot positions only in confirmed leaders while keeping stops tight.

analysis.analyst: CANSLIM / SEPA / Stage Analysis / Darvas Box

360ONE.technical: Cleared a 20-session consolidation on 2.25x volume with RSI at 59, reflecting healthy accumulation above key moving averages. Symmetrical swing lows formed a sound pivot breakout, though relative strength requires persistent volume follow-through.
360ONE.fundamental: While ARR AUM expanded to solid levels, Q2 FY27 net profit contracted 4.4% YoY due to mark-to-market impacts, breaking Q1's 34.2% growth. Top-line revenue rose only 4.8% YoY, missing CANSLIM minimum acceleration criteria.
360ONE.risk: Fails on a breakdown below the 1142.82 pivot stop; enforce immediate loss-cutting to prevent capital erosion.

63MOONS.technical: Constructing a double-bottom neckline breakout above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA with RSI at 56 and MACD positive. However, overhead supply from multi-year consolidation and erratic historical swings diminish clean institutional leadership.
63MOONS.fundamental: Despite Q1 FY27 revenue surging 350% YoY to ₹137.2 crore, the company posted an operating loss of ₹71.7 crore and net loss of ₹47.6 crore. Sub-5% multi-year ROE and earnings volatility fail O'Neil quality criteria.
63MOONS.risk: Thesis invalidates if price slips below the 883.03 swing low; exit decisively if neckline resistance triggers distribution.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Displays textbook Stage 2 leadership, holding cleanly above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. The 20-day high breakout followed a classic orderly pullback to the 21-EMA with RSI at 58, confirming heavy institutional accumulation.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Outstanding CANSLIM profile: Q2 FY27 PAT rose 38% YoY to ₹1,288 crore alongside 31% top-line growth to ₹16,545 crore. Total lending AUM expanded 32% to ₹2.34 lakh crore while credit costs dropped to seven-year lows of 92 bps.
ABCAPITAL.risk: Fails upon a violation of the 391.17 stop; cut losses immediately without second-guessing to preserve principal.

ABSLNN50ET.technical: Trading in an orderly Stage 2 trend above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. The ETF cleared 20-session resistance on 1.26x average volume with RSI at 66, capturing broad momentum across emerging large-cap constituents.
ABSLNN50ET.fundamental: As an exchange-traded fund tracking the Nifty Next 50 Index, individual earnings, revenue metrics, and ROCE ratios are not applicable. The instrument provides diversified, low-expense institutional participation across high-beta large-cap proxies.
ABSLNN50ET.risk: Invalidates below 76.15; execute a disciplined stop if the broader index loses moving average support.

ADANIENSOL.technical: Strong Stage 2 advance commanding the chart above 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. The 20-session breakout is supported by RSI at 60 and positive MACD alignment, showing constructive accumulation off support without short-term extension.
ADANIENSOL.fundamental: Superb earnings acceleration: Q2 FY27 PAT surged 148% YoY to ₹1,323 crore on 52.7% operational revenue growth to ₹10,076 crore. Operational EBITDA expanded 35.5% to ₹3,101 crore, supported by transmission commissioning and smart metering expansion.
ADANIENSOL.risk: Setup fails on a close below 1575.77; cut the trade swiftly to limit drawdown on high-beta equity.

ADANIGREEN.technical: Stage 2 structure sustained above upward-sloping 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. Price pushed to 20-day highs with RSI at 63 and positive MACD, though proximity to prior overhead resistance warrants volume confirmation.
ADANIGREEN.fundamental: Operational capacity reached 20.8 GW driving power supply revenue up 45% YoY to ₹4,019 crore with 92% EBITDA margins. However, consolidated PAT growth slowed to 15% YoY from 47% in Q1, and net debt-to-EBITDA remains elevated at 5.6x.
ADANIGREEN.risk: Fails if price breaches the 1326.34 pivot stop; adhere to stop rules to mitigate balance-sheet leverage risks.
